name: The Real Estate Voice: RSS to Blog and Listings
author: therealestatevoice

sections.description:
The Real Estate Voice plugin is built specifically for real estate agents and offices. It helps you:

  • Import fresh, relevant real estate blogs to your site via RSS
  • Expose your active, sold, and rented listings to The Real Estate Voice platform via a JSON API

Whether you’re a time-poor agent or an admin looking to simplify workflows, this plugin handles the heavy lifting of getting great content and listings online — fast.

Features

  • Add your RSS feed URL and schedule automatic imports
  • Expose your listings via /wp-json/trev/v1/properties
  • Support for sold, rented, and current listing states
  • Easy Property Listings (EPL) compatible
  • Dynamic settings page under Settings → The Real Estate Voice
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/the-real-estate-voice directory, or install via the WordPress Plugin Directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen.
  3. Visit Settings → The Real Estate Voice to configure your RSS and platform options.
  4. Listings are automatically exposed at: yourdomain.com/wp-json/trev/v1/properties
sections.faq:
Will this work with my current website?

Yes — as long as your site supports WordPress 5.6+ and PHP 7.4+, this plugin will run smoothly.

What does it integrate with?

Currently, it supports general WordPress posts and Easy Property Listings (EPL) for listing data. Support for other real estate themes and plugins is in development.
